becky: Quick pulse check — who wants a lunchtime boulder sprint challenge next week? 10min circuits, low drama.
omar: in. 10min is perfect.
quin: can we do a Weds lunchtime group?
tara: depends on climbing coach availability but probably yes.
becky: plan: Mon-Fri do a 10min circuit or stair sprints. post a tiny proof (pic or short note). 1pt/day.
omar: any prize? coffee?
becky: winner = coffee + digital crown. losers bring snacks. :smile:
quin: @poll-bot vote time — Weds group meetup at 12:30 or do solo?
poll-bot: POLL: "Weds meetup for Lunch Boulder Sprint" — Options: "12:30 PM group", "Solo (no meetup)" — Vote now!
tara: voted 12:30.
omar: voted solo.
becky: cool — looks like a small group might show. i'll make a tiny sheet: https://tinyurl.com/lunch-boulder-sprint
quin: added. see you all (or your sweaty selfies) next week. :clap:
